gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-ugaritic: Bevellier cuts its letters like stencil work, flat and tightly packed, each stroke traced as if with one marker tip. Noto Sans Ugaritic is the plain sans underneath, with open mouths and little gap between lowercase and capitals, so paragraphs flow smoothly.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-vai: Stencil-cut grace meets soft, solid text. Bevellier is best at striking ribbon-like headings of constant width, while Noto Sans Vai does its finest work in words that read as solid blocks with generous curves.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-vithkuqi: Bevellier has no modulation at all, its stems and connecting strokes matching like cut stencil. Noto Sans Vithkuqi sits below with open throats on a, c, e and s, keeping the sans text easy to move through.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-wancho: Bevellier looks like bent wire sign lettering, every stroke held to a constant thickness and set tight. And Noto Sans Wancho lands beneath it with a hulking, chalky lowercase, the plain sans that gives the page real weight.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-warang-cit: Bevellier looks like bent tubing, flat and graceful, with its high lowercase and very close sidebearings. Noto Sans Warang Citi follows in solid word-blocks with wide channels into each counter, so a long passage moves along smoothly.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-yi: Noto Sans Yi is a plain sans with a deep lowercase midsection and rounds left unlatched like a hook. And Bevellier above it hums in a soft, featureless way, stencil-flat and graceful, tightly spaced.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-zanabazar-: Noto Sans Zanabazar Square has a soaring x-height and wide gaps that keep tiny sizes crisp, a plain sans with friendly manners. Bevellier leaves a rolling-ball trail of single width; it handles display.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-traditional-nus: Noto Traditional Nushu writes with a broad-nibbed stroke that never curls shut. Bevellier, monoline from stem to serif, flat and stencil-cut, sits over it, and the sans-serif text fills each line generously.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-numans: Stencil-flat and tightly spaced. Bevellier ends every stroke at the same measured thickness, while Numans, a plain sans with swollen lowercase and far-hung s ends, feels loose and rope-like beside it.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-onest: Graceful and sophisticated, Bevellier cuts flat stencil strokes of single weight and sits tight, with a high wide-looking lowercase. Onest's big bowls and gentle monotone keep it friendly.
